intro.h2: A general contractor that specializes in bathrooms
paragraphs: North2South Renovations offers bathroom remodeling in Delray Beach, FL and across Palm Beach County from its base on Albatross Road. Founder and owner-operator Colby Matheny started the company to bring honesty and real craftsmanship back to South Florida remodeling. The team brings 15 years of hands-on renovation experience to every job, large or small.

Because North2South holds a Florida certified general contractor license, it can take a bathroom down to the studs, move plumbing, pull permits and pass inspections without handing you off. Google reviewers say the same thing in different words: Colby explains what to expect each day, sets clear expectations and follows through.

services.h2: Bathroom remodeling in Delray Beach, FL, plus kitchens and whole homes

items.name: Full Bathroom Renovations
items.blurb: Primary suites, guest baths and full gut renovations with walk-in showers, custom vanities, tile design and lighting upgrades. Materials are chosen to last in Florida's coastal climate. Recent work includes a fully renovated bathroom in Boca Raton with floating vanities and large-format tile.

image.alt: Renovated bathroom in Boca Raton, FL with a floating wood double vanity, arched brass mirrors and large-format beige porcelain walls

items.name: Shower and Tub-to-Shower Conversions
items.blurb: Old tubs and cramped stalls replaced with custom walk-in showers. The work runs through demolition, rough-in plumbing, waterproofing, tile, glass and fixtures, with GFCI outlets and new lighting circuits brought up to current code along the way.

image.alt: Remodeled bathroom with gray shaker double vanity, backlit mirrors and a marble-look walk-in shower with pebble floor

items.name: Kitchen Remodeling and Custom Cabinets
items.blurb: Full custom shaker, inset or semi-custom white cabinets, with quartz, quartzite and granite countertops. North2South says its team builds cabinets and fabricates countertops in-house, then installs them along with appliances, backsplash, flooring and any structural changes.

image.alt: Custom wood kitchen remodel with granite countertops, stained shaker cabinets and stainless appliances in Palm Beach County

items.name: Whole-Home Renovations
items.blurb: When the project spans several rooms, North2South manages permitting, scheduling, subcontractors, inspections and quality control as one point of contact. Whole-home work includes open-concept layouts, flooring, drywall and framing, trim and millwork, and custom closets.

about.text: Colby Matheny founded North2South Renovations with a plain goal: to redefine what South Florida homeowners can expect from a bathroom and home remodeling company, with honesty, craftsmanship and creativity at the center. He is the owner-operator, which means he is the person you meet at the consultation and the one reviewers thank by name at the end. Today the company is a certified general contractor based in Delray Beach, with 15 years of hands-on renovation experience across Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Delray Beach and Palm Beach Gardens.

image.alt: Colby Matheny of North2South Renovations with a team member in front of a green subway tile shower

process.h2: How a North2South bathroom remodel runs

steps.title: Consultation and design
steps.text: A free, in-depth consultation on your goals, style and budget, followed by a layout and visual plan for space, light and storage.

steps.title: Demolition and preparation
steps.text: Old fixtures, tile and flooring come out carefully. The crew hauls away debris and keeps the rest of your home clean and protected.

steps.title: Plumbing and electrical
steps.text: Pipes, drains and wiring are upgraded or moved to meet current code, including GFCI outlets, lighting circuits and shower or vanity plumbing.

steps.title: Waterproofing, tile and fixtures
steps.text: Waterproofing and flooring go in first, then wall tile, cabinetry, countertops, lighting finish, shower glass and accessories.

steps.title: Final inspection and walkthrough
steps.text: The finished bathroom is inspected and walked through with you so every detail is checked before the job closes.

service_area.h2: Serving Delray Beach and Palm Beach County
service_area.text: North2South is based at 3125 Albatross Rd in Delray Beach. The team remodels bathrooms and kitchens throughout Palm Beach County, including Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, West Palm Beach, Jupiter and Wellington. Kitchen projects on the site come from Jupiter and Palm Beach Gardens, and recent bathrooms from Boca Raton and Delray Beach. Not sure your street is covered? North2South asks you to call and describe the job.

items.a: Yes. North2South Renovations is a fully licensed and insured Florida certified general contractor, license CBC1269429. That license lets the company take on structural changes, additions and multi-trade projects, not only cosmetic updates, and it is printed in the footer of every page on the website.

items.q: Will my bathroom remodel need a permit?
items.a: Most bathroom renovations that move plumbing, change electrical or alter the structure need one. In Boynton Beach, for example, permits go through the City of Boynton Beach Building Department. As the general contractor, North2South handles permitting, inspections and code compliance for you.

Yes. North2South offers a free consultation. During it, the team will also tell you honestly whether your project needs a licensed general contractor or whether a specialty contractor would be enough for a smaller cosmetic job. Call (561) 664-3256 or use the contact form.

All of Palm Beach County, including Delray Beach, Boca Raton, Boynton Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, West Palm Beach, Jupiter and Wellington. If you are not sure your neighborhood is covered, the company asks you to call and talk through the project anyway.

items.q: What cabinet and countertop options do you offer?
items.a: Full custom shaker cabinets, inset cabinets for a seamless look, and semi-custom white cabinets that cost less and arrive sooner. Countertops come in quartz, quartzite and granite, and North2South says it fabricates them in-house for a precise fit in kitchens and bathroom vanities.
